$comment: Right-angle bevel drive on the bench, LDraw frame (-y up). Medium motor at the origin, port A. The 12T bevel sits on a 3L axle in the motor output at c1=(0,-75,0), teeth up (the bevel apex is local -z, LDraw file 6589.dat narrows towards -z). Its axis meets the 20T's at O=(0,-100,0): |c1-O|=25 = 20T pitch radius, |c2-O|=15 = 12T pitch radius. The 20T bevel is at c2=(15,-100,0) on a horizontal 4L axle along +x, teeth facing O. The frame: two Technic beams 7 standing upright beside the housing (x=40, z=+-20), each on two friction pins in the housing side holes s1/s5 and s3/s7, and a Technic beam 3 across their tops (x=60, y=-100, holes along x) on two friction pins; the 20T's axle turns in its middle hole. Frame and housing are one body.
